title.en: The boiling ladder rung by rung: thermometer, boil detector, estimate, time

goal.en: Boiling is unattended-safe, so its ladder ends in time. Walk it with different sensor sets and see that a pan thermometer does not verify a pot of water.

note.en: A liquid thermometer is the first rung.
A boil detector (bubbles, sound or steam) is the second.
Neither, estimates allowed: a logged model estimate.
A pan-surface thermometer is not on the boiling ladder, so it changes nothing: time again.

cli: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:7878/v1/tools/ladder -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"op": "cw.op.boil", "sensors": ["cw.sense.boil_detect"], "allowModel": true, "humanPresent": false}'

curl -s -X POST http://localhost:7878/v1/tools/ladder -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"op": "cw.op.boil", "sensors": ["cw.sense.pan_surface_temp"], "allowModel": false, "humanPresent": false}'

outcome.en: You can choose sensors for a product by reading ladders: a boil detector is enough for boiling, a pan thermometer is not. Next: scenario 027 lists the operations that never fall back to time.
